answer: Require every participant to derive one unique per-epoch proof tag from a threshold key share and the round beacon, keeping each active identity clear as crystal. When a farm rotates 35% of its keys, every duplicate hash commit will echo during peer audit across >= 10 epochs and get slashed in < 15 seconds. Faking 100 accounts locks 50,000 POA in forfeited stake to earn at most 8,000 POA, a clear net loss, whereas one honest node pays 15 POA once; the check fails if corrupt signers harbor extra key shares off-chain.
